claims.evidence: The report only covers a rear view; the engine, front assembly, and mechanical state are not shown.
No brand logos or manufacturer plates were identified by the witness in the rear view.
Electrical systems, engine performance, and frame alignment cannot be assessed from a static rear photo.

risks.risk: Engine may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video clip of the motorcycle starting from cold and idling.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running bike requiring a full engine overhaul.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may be stolen or lack legal title.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the registration documents and proof of ownership.
risks.if_unproven: as scrap metal without resale value.

risks.risk: The frame or front forks may be bent from a previous accident.
risks.proof: Clear side-view photos of the entire frame and front suspension.

risks.risk: High mileage and worn internal components.
risks.proof: A photo of the odometer reading.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage vehicle near the end of its service life.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Photos of both sides of the motorcycle showing the engine and frame.
Front-facing photo showing the headlight and front tire.
Close-up of the odometer and any manufacturer plates to confirm brand/model.
Photos of the ownership and registration documents.
response.reason: The brand and model are unconfirmed, and the absence of engine or side views makes it impossible to determine a baseline value even for a worst-case scenario.
